channel.title: OLD CITY CS LEAGUE
channel.description: counter-strike 1.6 · every winter · kompyuter kashkar, köhne diz · bring your own mouse

item.title: The club is closed
item.description: You know why. The government said the quarantine starts, and all the clubs, cafes and halls must close from tomorrow. Dilshat-aka told me in the shop with the lights half off. The final was supposed to be on the 7th, but we had to move it because of a funeral. Then we moved it to the 21st. Now it…

item.title: Semifinals
item.description: Sarchashma United vs Ak Gül, and the Misgaron Boys vs the uncles. The final should be 7 March. The club has been full for 10 weeks. Dilshat-aka looks tired but happy. The wall has 12 coloured names. Each year more.

item.title: SEASON 7
item.description: Last season of the decade. 28 teams. A new problem: Dilshat-aka's technician wants to leave for Almaty, so for the first time, I am also the one who knows how to fix the LAN. I carry a screwdriver now. I feel very serious.

item.title: One of us leaves
item.description: Our best AWP player, Anvar, received his call-up paper. He goes to the army in October. 10 days to say goodbye. We played a last friendly on dust2, he got 31 kills and cried quietly at the end. Then he ate three samsas. His team said: his slot stays free until he returns. We made a small plate and…

item.title: Diploma
item.description: Diploma. A "bachelor of computer science", from the Talas State University. My mother cried, my father took a photo with his phone and it is only the sky. I will work in a small company in the centre, in support. 1,800 som, with training. Madina says now we need to talk about the future. I said…

item.title: Tulpar
item.description: The team captains have a group on the new chat app, Tulpar. So much easier than the paper sheet at the shop. We decided the whole schedule of the next season in one evening: a captain wrote "can we play on Sunday?", 23 people said yes, 2 people said "why are we talking at 3 a.m.". The paper sheet…

item.title: SEASON 6
item.description: Season 6. 24 teams, 3 divisions. I made a spreadsheet to decide the groups and it took me 4 evenings. Nobody noticed except Madina, who said "you made a government".

item.title: Hourly price
item.description: Dilshat-aka raised the hourly price from 4 to 5 som. He told us himself, in the shop, with a cup of tea in his hand. The electricity bill is higher and the computers need new fans. He said "league nights stay at the old price for the teams", and he never explained the math. Some people complained.…

item.title: Strange final
item.description: Final: Temir-Kapka 5 vs the Lagers. 15 years of Old City hate, played out on nuke. The room was so full that the technician stood on a chair holding the router. The Lagers lost, they said it was lag. Everybody said "lagers with lag". The captain of the Lagers laughed. A good sign. I think the real…

item.title: SEASON 5
item.description: Because nobody asked, I will tell you: all the matches, all the results of five seasons are in a notebook with a green cover. 11,314 rounds. Yes I counted. No, it was not hard. The league is growing, and the room is not. Dilshat-aka is thinking about a second room, but the neighbour is a barber…
